summary: Turn many values into one result.
documentation: reduce passes a running accumulator through the array. Providing an initial value sets both its starting value and the result for an empty array.
inputs: A reducer callback and an optional initial accumulator.
caution: Reducing an empty array without an initial value throws. Pick a starting value that matches your result type.
scenarios: Add up invoice amounts in cents.
title: Total the cart
problem: Given an array of integer line totals in cents, return their sum. Return 0 for an empty cart. Negative values represent credits.
goal: Use Array.reduce() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
